scope: OpenTUI command palette order and surface
implementation: production OpenTUI frontend built from src/terminal/opentui/
input: isolated PTY at 80x24; / and the characters of "account" were sent one at a time
fixture: copied isolated verifier state and data; the controlled loopback provider was running for model catalog calls
rule: an exact name, a name prefix and a name part each rank above a description-only match
observed: /accounts Sign in, switch, check and remove Pi accounts
/resume Resume a session in this account and folder
selection: the /accounts row is first and selected
surface: only the command rows and their selection field; no border, title or key guide

captures.kind: actual PTY cumulative raw ANSI stream

limits: The capture covers the palette and composer only; it does not open the accounts page.
The fixture state is disposable and carries no user credentials.
